title: Shield AI Opens Bengaluru Engineering Office to Build Defence Autonomy Software
summary: The US defence technology company plans to hire Indian engineers to develop and test its Hivemind autonomy platform, expanding its presence beyond Delhi.
llm_summary: Shield AI, a U.S. defence‑tech firm, is opening a new engineering hub in Bengaluru to expand development of its Hivemind autonomous‑systems platform. The Bangalore office will recruit Indian software engineers to help build and test AI‑driven solutions for military applications, marking the company’s first major expansion outside its Delhi base. This move underscores the growing role of Indian talent in global defence‑technology innovation.
